clue.text: The sort of lighting to lay everything bare

definitions.meaning: long fluorescent tubes give this kind of lighting
to undress completely, or to remove every covering

explanation.surface: A remark about harsh lighting that leaves nothing hidden.
explanation.definitionFit: Fluorescent tube lighting goes by this name, and the verb means to undress or peel away all coverings.

clue.text: Show half the glasses?

definitions.meaning: a grand public display or sight
eyeglasses are a pair, so one half of them is the singular

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about a display of only part of a pair of eyeglasses.
explanation.definitionFit: A spectacular display is a show, and one lens of a pair of eyeglasses is the singular of the plural name.

clue.text: Put on the new wall covering up and down

definitions.text: Put on the new wall covering

indicators.note: in a down clue the word reads the same going up the grid as going down, a palindrome

parts.words: Put on the new wall covering
parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A decorator hangs new wallpaper all over the room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up and down' looks like part of the decorating scene, but says the down entry reads identically either way.
explanation.definitionFit: Hanging fresh wallpaper on a wall means giving it a new layer of decoration.

clue.text: They may be eaten by sanctimonious cardinals

parts.note: PI is short for pious, smugly religious
E and S, east and south, are two of the cardinal points of the compass

explanation.surface: Self-righteous churchmen of the highest rank sit down to dinner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cardinals' suggests church princes beside 'sanctimonious', but here means compass points.
explanation.definitionFit: Pastry dishes with fillings are food, things that get eaten.

clue.text: Feel affection for a famous essayist, but in a submissive way

parts.note: to like someone is to feel affection for them
Charles Lamb, English writer of the Essays of Elia

explanation.surface: A reader fond of a celebrated essayist, though meekly so.
explanation.definitionFit: The simile describes going meekly and without resistance, as gentle young sheep do.

clue.text: Don't panic! Just put on a sunhat

definitions.meaning: an instruction to stay calm
a hat in the sun literally keeps the head cool

explanation.surface: Calm advice to someone flustered by the heat: wear a hat.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means staying calm under pressure, and a sunhat literally stops the head from overheating.

clue.text: Does this book follow John?

definitions.meaning: performs, behaves
in the New Testament the book after John's Gospel is the ... of the Apostles

explanation.surface: A Bible question: which book comes after John's Gospel?
explanation.definitionFit: Performs is a sense of the verb, and the fifth New Testament book comes right after the Gospel of John.

clue.text: Let mail-order firm try to make such record sales

indicators.note: the words are put into a new order, rearranging their letters

explanation.surface: A catalogue company hopes its post-out sales break every record.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mail-order' reads as the firm's trade; 'order' is the anagram signal on LET MAIL. The answer is the adjective used in 'record sales', as in an unbeaten high.
explanation.definitionFit: An unsurpassed figure is the best ever, an all-time high in any period measured.

clue.text: The wholemeal variety may have some of its fibre added

indicators.note: only part of the letters of the following words are taken, a run sitting inside them

explanation.surface: Wholemeal loaves may contain extra roughage put in.
explanation.definitionFit: Wholemeal is a kind of loaf made from unrefined flour, a staple baked food.

clue.text: Say, is this the fast train?

definitions.meaning: to put into words, to state
a fast train with few stops

explanation.surface: A traveller on the platform asks whether this is the quick service.
explanation.definitionFit: To voice thoughts is to put them across in words, and a non-stopping rapid train has the same name.

clue.text: Get on your feet as the result of a regular payment by the bank

definitions.meaning: a command to rise, an order to stand

definitions.text: a regular payment by the bank
definitions.meaning: a bank instruction to pay a fixed sum at intervals

explanation.surface: Someone jumps up when told a regular bank payment has gone out.
explanation.definitionFit: A command to rise is literally an order for standing, and a recurring bank transfer has the same name.

clue.text: Is she French?

parts.note: the question 'is she' translated into French gives a French girl's name

explanation.surface: A question about a woman's nationality.
explanation.walkthrough: In French 'is she' is EST ELLE, which run together is a girl's name.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's name of French origin, as borne by the girl Pip loves in Great Expectations.

clue.text: Record a bit of the sonata, Perlman

indicators.note: only a short run of letters across the words is taken

explanation.surface: Recording part of a sonata played by violinist Itzhak Perlman.
explanation.definitionFit: To capture sound on magnetic ribbon is to record it.

clue.text: South African province of one's birth

definitions.meaning: the former province on South Africa's east coast
relating to being born

explanation.surface: A region of South Africa where someone was born.
explanation.definitionFit: The former province on South Africa's east coast shares its name with the adjective for birth.

clue.text: Generous sort

definitions.meaning: kindly, giving
type or variety

explanation.surface: A description of a giving type of person.
explanation.definitionFit: A benevolent person is good-natured, and the same word means a type or category.

clue.text: The outstanding talent of a famous hotelier

definitions.meaning: a person's strong point
Charles ..., founder of the Trusthouse ... hotel group

explanation.surface: What a celebrated hotel magnate is especially good at.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone's strong point is their special talent, and Lord Forte built a famous British hotel empire.

clue.text: I'd go after a great number when seeing the king

indicators.note: the following piece is placed after the large number

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
taken as written without the apostrophe
as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

explanation.surface: Someone at the back of a huge queue waiting to see a monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: The king is the legendary Phrygian ruler whose touch turned everything to gold.
explanation.definitionFit: The legendary king of Phrygia granted the golden touch.

clue.text: Rob Cox died in a strange way from this gas

indicators.note: the letters are arranged in an odd new way

explanation.surface: A man called Rob Cox met an odd death caused by a gas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a' belongs to the fodder: ROB COX DIED IN A has thirteen letters, rearranged by 'strange way'.
explanation.definitionFit: The gas exhaled in breathing and produced by burning is a compound of carbon and oxygen.

clue.text: Give direction to a disaffected Socialist?

definitions.meaning: an instruction telling a driver which way to go
a leftist who changes allegiance swings to the political right

explanation.surface: Advice to a disillusioned left-winger about which way to go.
explanation.definitionFit: A road instruction to go starboard, and a socialist who abandons the left moves rightwards politically.

clue.text: Certificate giving the right to manufacture tan material for fashion accessories

parts.words: Certificate giving the right to manufacture
parts.note: a patent grants exclusive rights to make an invention
to leather someone is to thrash them, as is to tan their hide

explanation.surface: A licence lets a firm produce brown material for handbags and shoes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tan' looks like a colour of hide but is the verb meaning thrash.
explanation.definitionFit: Glossy varnished hide is used for shoes and handbags, typical fashion accessories.

clue.text: Dad finished making a cake

parts.note: pop is an informal word for father
over means ended

explanation.surface: Father has finished baking a cake.
explanation.definitionFit: A light hollow batter bake that rises over its tin, a kind of small cake or muffin.

clue.text: Man with a token of engagement gets an audience

parts.note: he is a male pronoun
an engagement ring is given when a couple become betrothed

explanation.surface: An engaged man is granted a formal meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal audience is a chance to be listened to, as a court session or interview.

clue.text: Northerner in Los Angeles meets the President twice

indicators.note: the single letter for the president is used two times over

parts.note: P is an abbreviation for president

explanation.surface: Someone from the far north visiting California meets the head of state twice.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of the Sami people of far northern Scandinavia, an Arctic dweller.

clue.text: Certainly Richard Lovelace's poetry contains it

indicators.note: the words hold a run of letters within them

explanation.surface: Richard Lovelace's verse certainly holds something.
explanation.walkthrough: Richard Lovelace was a 17th-century Cavalier poet known for short songlike verses.
explanation.definitionFit: Short songlike verse expressing personal feeling is the kind Lovelace wrote.

clue.text: Firm Communist gets disheartened

parts.note: CO is short for company, a firm
red is the traditional label for a communist

explanation.surface: A dedicated party member becomes downhearted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disheartened' here means with the heart taken out, as an apple's centre is removed.
explanation.definitionFit: Fruit with its centre removed has had its heart taken out.

clue.text: Soft melody written as a duet

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly
an air is a tune

explanation.surface: A gentle tune composed for two performers.
explanation.definitionFit: A duet is performed by two, a couple of voices or players.

clue.text: The goddess with a double existence

indicators.note: the short word is given twice in a row

parts.note: is is the verb of existing

explanation.surface: A deity who leads two lives at once.
explanation.definitionFit: The Egyptian mother goddess, wife of Osiris.

clue.text: Break for an aspiring actor

definitions.meaning: to separate or divide
a role is what a hopeful actor seeks

explanation.surface: A hopeful performer waits for a lucky break.
explanation.definitionFit: To divide is to separate, and an acting role is what a hopeful performer wants.

clue.text: Verse I'd corrected

indicators.note: a corrected text has its parts rearranged

explanation.surface: A poet admits to having amended their lines.
explanation.definitionFit: Corrected work has been amended, gone over and altered.

clue.text: The artist's work is attractive

definitions.meaning: a sketch or picture done in pencil
pulling people in

explanation.surface: A painter's latest piece proves appealing.
explanation.definitionFit: A sketch is an artist's product, and something that pulls in crowds is said to be alluring.

clue.text: Opener for an Irish county's rowing team

parts.note: County Cork is in the south of Ireland
a crew mans a rowing boat

explanation.surface: A man chosen to lead off for a rowing team from an Irish county.
explanation.definitionFit: A spiral tool for drawing stoppers from wine bottles opens them.

clue.text: What the niggardly drunkard usually is

definitions.meaning: mean with money
a drunk is usually in this state

explanation.surface: What the miserly boozer typically is.
explanation.definitionFit: A stingy person is mean with money, and a heavy drinker is often intoxicated; the word covers both.
